Good evening team,
The kennel lead sent an update on waiting areas

Please keep the front desk language warm, calm, and direct when you answer questions from travelers and handlers. If someone arrives unsure about check-in flow, walk them through the next step in simple terms and avoid making assumptions about what they already know. Our tone should stay friendly while still protecting the standards that make companion travel work smoothly at Aurelia Skyways.

For routine cases, make sure the paperwork is complete, the carrier labels match the booking notes, and the pet handoff is explained in plain language. If a traveler like Emil Cohen or Alina Kaur needs reassurance, listen first, then give a clear summary of what will happen next. When a pet such as Suki is involved, keep the focus on comfort, safety, and a steady pace so the traveler feels supported and the animal stays settled.

Also remember to flag anything unusual right away rather than waiting for a later shift handover. Small issues are easier to resolve when the desk shares them early, and that helps us keep dependable companion travel in place for every customer who comes through. Please keep your notes brief, accurate, and readable, and use the same careful approach when speaking in person or by message. Thank you for keeping the Companion Animal Travel Desk steady and welcoming for everyone.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
